unsupported: The company provides a full spectrum of packaging services under one roof: custom printing via digital and rotogravure presses for flexible films, labels, shrink sleeves, tamper bands, and retail cartons; conversion of those materials into stand-up, gusseted, flat, and pillow pouches, sachets, jars, tubes, and canisters, including eco-friendly recyclable and compostable options; co-packing using vertical form-fill-seal (VFFS) machines, flow wrappers, and carousel fillers for pet treats, human snacks, powders, and liquid products; and fulfillment covering e-commerce and retail pick-and-pack, POS assembly, lot-tracked warehousing, and daily LTL/FTL and parcel shipping. Runs range from small batches to high-volume production.
Elite serves brands in the pet-food, human-food, and specialty-food sectors, as well as e-commerce and retail distributors.
